content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Your current digital store on Gumroad or Stripe is locked out of your market due to restrictions or high fees. With our infrastructure, you own the entire payment and delivery pipeline, bypassing platform fees. Our Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a customized solution, tailored to your needs, with Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Workers for logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. You'll never pay more than 0.5% on every sale, with no platform dependencies. This means you can sell ebooks to customers in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or other restricted markets without worrying about fees or intermediaries.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying our infrastructure, you need a digital product, a unique product slug, and a Cloudflare account. You'll also need to create a NOWPayments account, which requires a valid email address and a payment method. Additionally, you'll require a Supabase account for order storage. You'll need to upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Our Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes everything you need for a turnkey solution, deployed in 48 hours. This includes a complete setup of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages site. You'll need to create a new worker to handle payments and automate delivery. For delivery, you'll need to configure Cloudflare R2 to serve files from your Google Drive account. Our Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes everything you need for a seamless integration, with a complete setup of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This means you can automate delivery and collect payments without intermediaries, with a fee of 0.5% on every sale.
You'll save $921 per month at 100 sales with this infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you can go live and start processing transactions. You'll need to configure your Cloudflare Pages site to accept payments, and set up a webhook to notify you of incoming payments. With NOWPayments, you'll receive automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, ensuring that every transaction is secure and verified. Our Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes everything you need for a turnkey solution, deployed in 48 hours, with a complete setup of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This means you can process transactions and deliver products to customers without worrying about fees or intermediaries.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running, you can scale your business with confidence. Our Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed for growth, with a complete setup of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This means you can add more products, increase sales, and expand your customer base without worrying about fees or intermediaries. You'll never pay more than 0.5% on every sale, with a seamless integration of payment and delivery pipelines. This means you can focus on creating more ebooks, and expanding your business without worrying about the underlying infrastructure.
